dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Loki is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Loki has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to hard bark, lunge, and snap at handlers when they attempt to interact with handlers. In his previous, Loki was reported to display similar behaviors. Noted to hard bark, growl, and snap at strangers. Loki's previous owner describes him as an independent dog that loves going to the park. Medically, Loki is apparently healthy.

Loki arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as an independent dog that loves going to the park. While in care, Loki has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to escalate to lunging, hard barking, and snapping when handlers attempt to interact. In his previous home Loki was reported to hard bark, growl, and snap at strangers. Due to the detailed behaviors, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
